querystring.select: SELECT ST.SRVY_TASK_NO AS SrvyTaskNo, SFS.SRVY_FORM_SCHM_NAME AS SrvyFormSchmName, ST.MR_SRVY_SUBJ_CODE AS MrSrvySubjCode, ST.MR_SRVY_OBJ_CODE AS MrSrvyObjCode, ST.MR_SRVY_SUBJ AS MrSrvySubj, ST.MR_SRVY_OBJ AS MrSrvyObj, ST.MR_SRVY_STAT_CODE AS MrSrvyStatCode, ST.SURVEYOR_CODE AS SurveyorCode, ST.SRVY_TASK_ID AS SrvyTaskId
querystring.from: FROM dbo.SRVY_TASK ST WITH(NOLOCK) INNER JOIN dbo.SRVY_FORM_SCHM SFS WITH(NOLOCK) ON SFS.SRVY_FORM_SCHM_ID = ST.SRVY_FORM_SCHM_ID
